stories.title: Create BEV C04 Knowledge Assessment with Electric Motor Diagnostics Questions
stories.description: Build comprehensive Knowledge Assessment for BEV C04 (Electric Drive Train and Power Electronics) with 40+ MCQ and short-answer questions covering electric motor diagnostics, power electronics safety, and all Assessment Criteria from NOSS standard.
acceptanceCriteria: KA.md contains minimum 30 MCQ questions + 10 short-answer questions covering all C04 Related Knowledge items: electric motor theory, DC/AC drive systems, power electronics, inverter operation, safety protocols for high-voltage systems
Each MCQ includes answer key, technical explanation, and difficulty level; short-answer questions include model answers and competency rubric (Novice/Competent/Advanced)
Assessment document structure matches WIM format: [G452-010-3:2023-C04]/KA([seq]/[total]) with mapping to all 12 C04 Assessment Criteria from NOSS standard
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/KA.md (~200 lines, markdown format with embedded answer schemes)
Validation script: bev-diagnostic-rectification/_scripts/validate_ka_coverage.py (checks all Assessment Criteria covered)
Test command: uv run python bev-diagnostic-rectification/_scripts/validate_ka_coverage.py --doc C04/KA.md

stories.title: Audit IT-020-3 Competency Unit Structure and Generate Content Scaffold
stories.description: Implement IT-020 Level 3 structure audit tool that reads existing textbook content, maps competency units, validates WIM format compliance, and generates folder scaffold with 00-noss-extract.md listing all CUs, Related Knowledge items, and Work Activities.
acceptanceCriteria: Script audit detects all competency units in noss-it020-textbook folder and lists them with count of Related Knowledge items and Work Activities from source material
Generates it-computer-system/00-noss-extract.md with complete CU listing in WIM format (one line per CU with RK count, WA count, Assessment Criteria count)
Creates missing CU folder structure (C01/, C02/, C03/, C04/, C05/) if not present, with proper document placeholders (PM-teori.md, PM-amali.md)
technicalNotes: File to create: it-computer-system/_scripts/scaffold_it_cus.py (~100 lines, reads from noss-it020-textbook reference path)
Output file: it-computer-system/00-noss-extract.md (auto-generated, validates against WIM Buku Panduan format)

stories.title: Implement Aesthetic Services Bilingual Terminology Validator for Assessment Documents
stories.description: Build Python tool to audit KA (Knowledge Assessment) and KK (Work Sheets) documents in Aesthetic module for consistent bilingual terminology (EN + BM). Tool validates against glossary and reports missing or inconsistent term pairs across all competency units.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator script scans all aesthetic-services/**/KA.md and /**/KK.md files, extracts technical terms (anatomy, modalities, safety concepts), and cross-checks against bilingual glossary

Glossary file (_terms-glossary.json) seeded with 50+ modality names (Ultrasound/Ultasonik, Galvanic/Galvanik, etc.), anatomy terms (deltoid/deltoid, pectoralis/pectoralis), and assessment terminology with BM translations

Validator generates audit report showing: (a) missing bilingual pairs by document, (b) inconsistent terminology usage (same term translated differently across CUs), (c) Terms lacking BM translation or marked as incomplete
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/_scripts/validate_bilingual_terms.py (~120 lines, regex+JSON matching for term extraction and glossary validation)
Glossary file: aesthetic-services/_terms-glossary.json (JSON dict with EN key mapping to BM value, seeded and extensible)
Test command: uv run python aesthetic-services/_scripts/validate_bilingual_terms.py --report --output /tmp/bilingual-audit.txt && grep -c 'missing\|inconsistent' /tmp/bilingual-audit.txt
